name: Drill Blocks for Brainrots
desc:
⛏️ Drill Blocks for Brainrots! 

⛏️ Drill insane blocks to uncover rare Brainrots!
💰 Collect and place Brainrots on your plot to earn cash!
⚡ Upgrade your drills to mine faster & go deeper!
🔥 Unlock crazy new zones, blocks, and powerful drills!

🤩 Thank you for playing! Like and favorite if you enjoy the game!
